title: planAudit
responsibility: Reports missing proposal sections, acceptance items, measurement plans and request overlap using explicit structural heuristics.

inputs.name: planAudit.proposal
inputs.description: Substantive Markdown proposal to inspect structurally without implementing its planned behavior.

inputs.name: planAudit.goal
inputs.description: User-facing task goal used for the committed contract and explicit word-overlap heuristic.

outputs.name: planAudit
outputs.description: Individual structural heuristic checks; a passing result does not prove arbitrary semantic fulfillment.
